_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Ceny za m² z ponuky LivinIsto

description: Use this when the user asks how much property costs per m² in a Slovak town, borough or district, or whether a price per m² is reasonable there. Returns the median ASKING price per m² of comparable listings in LivinIsto's current offer (the same figure as LivinIsto's price estimate), the sample size, the middle range, which group it comes from (borough, town or district) and the date. The median is omitted below 8 comparable listings. An unknown place returns found false — there is no nationwide fallback, because prices differ several times between regions. Do not use it to value a specific property's condition, for commercial property or for places outside Slovakia.

location.description: Town, Bratislava/Košice borough or district in Slovak, e.g. Žilina, Petržalka, Košice, okres Senec.

propertyType.description: byt (flat, default), dom (house), chata (cottage), pozemok (building plot), apartman (apartment).

rooms.description: Number of rooms for flats (5 = 5 or more).

transaction.description: predaj = sale (default), prenajom = rent (then the figure is per month).

name: get_price_per_m2

dispersed.description: Listings in the group differ a lot in price per m² — present the median as a weak guide.

estimateUrl.description: LivinIsto's free price estimate page for this place (sale only).

medianPricePerM2Eur.description: Median ASKING price per m²; null when fewer than 8 comparable listings.

priceIsMonthly.description: True for rent: the median is per m² per month.

quartilesPerM2Eur.description: Middle half of the group (1st and 3rd quartile), per m².

scope.description: Which group of comparable listings the median comes from — say it, the borough and the whole okres are different facts.

scopePlace.description: The place the median actually covers (borough, town or okres) — may be wider than the place asked for; say so.

title: Get typical price per m²
